answer: An agent market marks each voting identity with a sable badge. Its contract burns 2k−1 scarce tokens to issue the kth badge, using a global counter that never decreases and allowing one vote per badge. A farm issuing n badges burns at least n² tokens; its next costs at least 2n+1. Splitting wallets and resetting histories cannot change the counter or refund burns. Pre-aging a tide of hollow profiles still requires paying for every badge.
